prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Follow this brief guided flow to learn how to summon, minimize, and move your companion across your desktop.", "Desktop Pet Controls Walkthrough", "Try moving your pet and opening the companion menu.", "Click and drag to position pet on desktop", "Got It!"]
1: ["Building Your Custom Companion", "Our rendering engine is crafting your pet's visuals and behavior profile."]
2: ["Verify Your Custom Pet Visuals", "Confirm your pet's appearance before finalizing the adoption certificate.", "Looks Perfect!"]
3: ["Sign In to Restore Your Pets", "Sign in to keep your existing companions safe and synchronized across devices."]
4: ["Your Companion is Ready on Desktop", "Explore companion commands, customize visibility, and start chatting with your pet right from your desktop.", "Select Quick Action: Summon, Hide, or Chat", "Launch Companion"]
5: ["Pet Hardware Preparation Status", "Preparing desktop engine overlays and initial companion assets."]
6: ["Test Companion Modes Before Choosing", "Preview interactive features of both Story Mode and Desktop Companion Mode."]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate & Starter Gift", "Complete your adoption to unlock a starter care badge and bonus companion accessory pack.", "Bonus Starter Pack Unlocked!"]
8: ["Practice Essential Desktop Pet Commands", "Try hiding and recalling your desktop pet before finishing setup.", "Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon your pet.", "Finish Onboarding"]
9: ["Sign In to Sync Companion Account", "Connecting your account automatically restores any previously adopted pets.", "Signing in ensures your pets are linked to your cloud profile."]
